newsitem.title: IRAQ: Emirates ports official in Iraq to boost trade.
newsitem.headline: Emirates ports official in Iraq to boost trade.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates has sent a senior ports official to Iraq to ease the flow of Iraq-bound goods from Dubai, the official al-Iraq newspaper reported on Friday.

The paper said Sultan Ahmad Bin Saleem, director-general of Dubai's Ports and Customs Department, met Iraq's Communications and Transport Minister Ahmed Murtada Ahmed Khalil on Thursday and expressed "U.A.E.'s readiness...to do its utmost to secure the arrival of food and medical stuffs to Iraq".
Iraq is diverting part of its trade to Dubai whose duty free markets, Iraqi traders say, offer cheaper and better goods than neighbouring countries.
